name: frog
groundRowNote: 0-based bottom cell row. Every frame's lowest opaque pixel is on row 14 - all eight are bottom-aligned, with no baked vertical lift. The engine supplies the whole hop arc.
pivotNote: Draw the cell so this pixel sits on the ground line the frog hops along. x=10 is the body centre between the feet. Add the hop's vertical translation in engine code only.

frames.name: idle-blink
frames.note: eyes closed, throat puffs 1px; pairs with 0

frames.name: crouch
frames.note: anticipation: body compressed 2px, head tucked, feet pulled in under the belly

frames.name: push-off
frames.note: hind leg straightened and driven back to the ground line, front legs lifted, body pitched nose-up

frames.name: airborne
frames.note: body elongated to 18px wide and flattened, all four limbs stretched to the cell corners

frames.name: landing
frames.note: hard squash: lowest and widest frame, feet splayed, head down

paletteNote: All eight are documented Dewdrop Bend world-palette colours. ink = selective outline + pupil, leaf-dark = mouth line, cream = eye glint, throat sac and belly highlight.
transparency: alpha 0 in every unused cell pixel; no matte colour, no baked shadow.
